## read combined event table?

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr) # not yet cited! rmb to add

# obtain the list of files path inside my event tables folder
files <- list.files(
  path = "event_tables", 
  pattern = "_unfiltered", 
  full.names = TRUE
)

files

# purpose: read every csv event table and combine all csv into 1 big dataframe called all_files
# map_df means put the list of files (variable files) as input, and apply the function onto each element
all_files <- purrr::map_df(.x = files, function (individual_event_table){
  file_name <- individual_event_table |>   # obtain the basename (without the folder name, only file name), store as variable
    basename()
  
  table <- read_csv(individual_event_table) # read the csv table and store as variable table
  table <- table |>             # create a new column called file_name,and update our variable table
    mutate(file_name = file_name)
  }
  )

# remove extension .csv
all_files <- all_files %>%
  mutate(
    file_no_ext = str_replace(file_name, "\\.csv$", ""), # \\ is the escape character to type  dot
    # the sign $ means to grab the .csv only if this string appears at the last of the current string 
    file_prefix = str_replace(file_no_ext, "_unfiltered", ""),
    event_number_padded = sprintf("%05d", `Event Number`), # make event number become 5 digits
    event_id = paste0(file_prefix, "_ev", event_number_padded, "_rec", `Record`)
  )

all_files <- all_files %>%
  select(-file_name, -file_no_ext, -event_number_padded)


# create a new column and assume every event is real event (not noise)
all_files <- all_files |>
  mutate(
    noise = "no"
  )


all_files <- all_files %>%
  mutate(event_entry_number = dplyr::row_number())


# read the noise table of event that were flagged as noise previously by ML model and passed my inspection



noise_events <- read_csv("C:/Users/silic/Desktop/master_project_updated_pipeline_backup/noise_labeling/events_to_label/other_noise/noise.csv",
                   col_names = TRUE)
View(noise_events)


all_files <- all_files %>%
  mutate(
    noise = if_else(event_id %in% noise_events$event_id, "yes", "no")
  )


View(all_files)

# save the big event table that has the noise column (of yes/no)
write_csv(all_files, "all_events_with_noise.csv")
# 508758 rows

all_files_no_noise <- all_files %>%
  filter(noise == "no")

# save the big event table that has noise removed
write_csv(all_files_no_noise, "all_events_no_noise.csv")
# 505516 rows


```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Load your big event table
events <- read.csv("C:/Users/silic/Downloads/bitbucket backup/all_events_no_noise.csv")

View(events)

# 2. Split into list of dataframes by recording prefix
split_list <- split(events, events$file_prefix)
split_list # why is there only 471 elements?

length(unique(events$file_prefix))

# 3. Write each recording's events to its own CSV
output_folder <- "sorted_events"
dir.create(output_folder, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (recording in names(split_list)) {
  out_path <- file.path(output_folder, paste0(recording, "_events.csv"))
  write.csv(split_list[[recording]], out_path, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved: ", out_path)
}

```
